description: Forgivable loans of up to $5,000 per semester for students who commit to teaching elementary education, special education, or a STEM field in an NC public school; one year of teaching forgives each year of funding.
eligibility_text: High school applicants (or fewer than 24 college credit hours) need a minimum unweighted high school GPA of 3.0; must be admitted to a partner institution to accept funding; commit to teaching elementary education, special education, or a STEM field in an NC public school. Early action by November 1, 2026; the 2027-28 application closes February 14, 2027.

renewal_terms: A forgivable loan, not a grant: repaid by teaching in an NC public school one year per year funded.

essay_prompts: Why you are inspired to enter teaching, and why elementary education, special education, or a STEM field (250-500 words).
A time you faced a challenge or adversity and how you overcame it (250-500 words).
Your school activities, accomplishments, leadership, jobs, and community service and why they matter (250-500 words).

sponsor: UNC System / NC Teaching Fellows Commission
title: North Carolina Teaching Fellows
